chat.t: Hello, hello!☆
You have time today, right?
I have an extremely urgent matter.
It's something that needs to be solved right now.
And a very serious one at that...
I'm bored.
I'm bored to death.
So play with me!

o: Is that something an educator should say?

chat.t: A teacher's life is just the same day repeating over and over.
Teaching at set times, preparing classes at set times...
Doing that every day is beyond boring, it's exhausting!

o: Well, playing around is my specialty.
Sure, how do you want to play?

chat.t: Oho, now you're speaking my language!
Then first, come to my laboratory.
We have a special connection, so you can just open the door and come right in.
You know the lab passcode, right?
I'll be waiting!☆

o: You don't even have a digital door lock there.

chat.t: Sigh...
It's a bit awkward for me to say this after asking for it,
but I didn't expect it to go this far.
I thought my back was going to snap.

o: I only did exactly what you asked for.

chat.t: You showed absolutely no mercy even when I begged you to stop.
I never imagined I'd be down on my knees begging for over an hour.

o: You did say you wanted it to be intense.

chat.t: Well, that is true, but...
It's actually pretty terrifying to think there might be real students like this.
Still, I did learn a valuable lesson in my own way.
So I guess today's teacher-student play was relatively successful.
That I should be careful about who I ask for favors.

lines.t: Hari's Laboratory
Hari was sitting at her desk, reading a book.
Ah, you're here?
Just wait a second. Let me put away this book I was reading.
What book is that?
It's a reference book for our play today.
So you've already decided what we're going to do?
Of course.
After all, the thirsty man must dig the well.
The moment you said you were coming, I had already decided what we'd do!☆
With that said, today we are playing house.
What do you mean, playing house? We're not kids.
It's called playing house, but it's not your ordinary game.
An adult version, then?
Well... I guess you could see it that way.
Today, we're playing teacher.
It might look like a joke at first, but this is no simple game.
It's an indirect experience of professional roles through play.
For someone already in that profession, experiencing it indirectly through play allows them to see things from a different perspective than their usual role.
That way, it improves their professional skills and teaches them how to handle unexpected situations.
And when it comes to creating unexpected situations, you are the perfect fit.
What exactly do you take me for?
Let's do this right now.
Great, then let's start right away.
Naturally, I am the teacher. You know that, right?
Teacher! Tell us about your first love!
...You got into character fast.
Ahem...!
Silence!
We need to get through the lesson. Chatting is for later!
Is my acting a bit awkward?
Not just a bit. A lot.
It sounded like you were just reading from a textbook.
Hmm...
But you're acting exactly as I expected.
I can't be surprised by something I already predicted.
Can't you make things a bit more exciting?
How exciting do you want it to be?
Show me a demonstration.
Something like this...?
You're the student, and I'm the teacher!
If you're a student, behave like one and hold your brush to study!
...'Hehehe! Teacher, instead of the brush, why don't you hold mine?' is what you'd say?
Asking the teacher for a secret private lesson...
Sexually harassing me without a care in the world...
To think you were looking at your teacher with those eyes...
You really are a bad student...!
So, what minute does the real action start?
Are you trying to shoot an adult video?
Well, it has to be at least this level to throw me off.
Don't tell me that book you were reading earlier...
Ah, you noticed?
It was a manga called 'The Teacher's Secret Lesson: That's Not a Brush'.
One of my students was actually reading it during class.
So I confiscated it for a week, and it turned out to be surprisingly interesting.
So, can you play along with this kind of scenario?
With pleasure.
As long as you're prepared.
I teased Hari relentlessly until she was crying and begging me to stop, and then I came back.

chat.t: Do you like fishing?

o: That came completely out of nowhere.

chat.t: Anyway, do you like fishing or not?
If you're interested, come to the Hundred Schools of Thought.
You can even catch golden carp in our lake.

o: Why would I go all that way just for some golden carp?

chat.t: It's a famous delicacy known for tasting like beef...
I got to feel like a student again after a long time.
Thanks for giving me a nice break.
Or should I say, thanks for teaching me how to skip class properly?
The favor I promised to grant you?
Alright.
I'll give you a coupon for one wish, and I'll grant whatever you ask.
It's valid starting 100 years from now up to 1,000 years.
Be grateful! I gave you a generous window of 900 years.

lines.t: Hari's Laboratory
Is anyone home?!
Oh? You actually came.
I thought you weren't coming.
How could I resist when I'm so curious?
The carp that tastes like beef.
Did you really come just for that?
It's a bit awkward to say this after inviting you, but...
I didn't actually expect you to show up.
But since you're here, I should treat you as my guest, right?
Now, follow me.
Four Gentlemen Park
This is Four Gentlemen Park, one of the famous landmarks in Four Gentlemen.
There's also a legend that the Dragon Deity is sleeping here...
Well, there's no way it's true. It's just a typical legend.
The lake is huge for a park.
The founders of Four Gentlemen built it.
They built it for some really silly reason.
Something about how a lake absolutely has to be huge.
Well, I quite like it because it's spacious and gives me a place to relax.
So what's the real reason you had me come over?
The reason? I invited you to see if you wanted to go fishing.
Not your nominal excuse.
The real reason you called me.
You're quicker on the uptake than I thought.
I'll have to reevaluate you, fufu.
When a guest personally visits an educator, that educator must prioritize receiving the guest.
That's a rule that applies to us teachers of the Hundred Schools of Thought.
When I woke up this morning, I was like, 'Ah, the weather is so nice, I can't be bothered to go to class☆'.
So I decided to use the rules of the Hundred Schools of Thought.
If you come as a guest, I can skip class under the pretext of hosting you!
So you called me just to play hooky?
Play hooky?
Please call it a legitimate guest reception to develop the Hundred Schools of Thought.
It feels a bit weird for me to say this, but...
Is a teacher really allowed to do that?
Hmm... probably not, right?
But!
Enlightenment in learning isn't something that happens just because someone teaches you.
Only when you realize it on your own can you truly say you've learned and mastered it.
My skipping class is actually to impart that very lesson.
Even though you literally just admitted you couldn't be bothered to go to class?
But I really don't want to go to class.
And it's such a hassle...
I'm already too busy with my own research...
Seriously, why don't teachers get any vacations?!
In that case, you've come to the right place.
Let me show you how to truly slack off.
Ooooh!
So that makes you the master of slacking?
I'll be in your care then!☆
If you teach me well, I'll grant you a wish!
Any wish?
As long as it's not too dirty...?
Let's start right now.
I returned after teaching Hari the true essence of slacking off.

chat.t: What is freedom?

o: What kind of nonsense is that?
You sound like you're begging to get locked up in Panoticon.

chat.t: I got into a fight with another teacher today, and I suddenly became curious.
Have you never thought about it?
Freedom, freedom... freewheeling, doing whatever I want...

Freedom... independence, rights, liberation... escape, comfort,
openness, vastness, travel, spontaneity, going with the flow...

What flows is wind, sunlight, the sun, moon, stars, star candy,
sweet stuff, snacks, getting in trouble if caught sneaking them...

o: How far are you going with this?

chat.t: Getting in trouble, I hate getting in trouble, what I hate is class...

o: You're already not even paying attention...

chat.t: Are you really not interested in working at the Hundred Schools of Thought?

o: Nope, absolutely not, not a chance.

chat.t: It's a loss for all of humanity if talent like yours is just wasted...
But I guess it can't be helped. Forcing people goes against our philosophy.
I'll just have to be satisfied with gaining this enlightenment.
But if you ever change your mind, let me know anytime.
The Hundred Schools of Thought is always open.

o: That's never going to happen in a million years.

lines.t: Hari's Laboratory
Freedom, what is freedom?
Hmm.
Class, class is a hassle, if it's a hassle, play hooky...
Slacking is learned, those who learn are students... Oh, when did you get here?
Just how far does your train of thought go?
This is also a research method.
It's a state-of-the-art research method where you associate things freely without limit to reach a conclusion.
It even has a name.
It's called 'Lady Hari's Special Research Method'.
...So, what brings you here?
Could it be you came because you were worried about my research?
My, my, I had no idea you cared about me this much!
Hmph, who says I care?
Whether you work hard on your research or not is none of my business.
Is this that 'tsundere' thing that students these days seem to love so much?
So, what's your real purpose for coming?
Since you're my student now, I'm taking responsibility for you until the very end.
Your student?
Ah!
I see, it's an extension of our slacking off.
In that case, shall I receive my master's teachings?
Master, what do you think freedom is?
Having absolutely no thoughts.
What is that supposed to mean?
What does having no thoughts have to do with freedom...
Wait.
Usually when people think of freedom, they think of being able to do whatever they want.
But is that truly what it means to be free? To be freewheeling?
The very moment you think about doing what you want, aren't you already not free?
Just having absolutely no thoughts. Letting your body move without thinking.
To embody it so completely that you don't even have to conceptualize freedom...
That is true freedom...
So this is the realization you wanted to give me!
You really are amazing!
No, seriously, I just said it without thinking...
Yes, this is learning! This is academia!
Thinking for oneself, realizing, and finding the answer—that is true learning!
For the first time in a while, my soul as a researcher is burning!
No, seriously, I just said it without thinking...
You might actually have a talent for teaching.
To think I'd find such a talented individual here...
How about it? Why don't you work as a teacher at the Hundred Schools of Thought too?
I'll give you a strong recommendation.
I learned that you should never work under a professor.
Wait, wait!
If a talent like you just sits around, it's a loss for all of humanity, you know?
W-Wait!
A wish coupon! I'll even let you use a wish coupon starting tomorrow!
No, I'll let you use it starting today!
I escaped a future of becoming a slave.
